title: useDebounceFn Hook
description:
Implement a `useDebounceFn` hook that returns a debounced version of `fn`. The debounced function waits `delay` ms after the last call before invoking `fn`. Rapid successive calls reset the timer.

**Example:**
```tsx
const debouncedSearch = useDebounceFn((q: string) => search(q), 300);
<input onChange={e => debouncedSearch(e.target.value)} />
```
ai_context: A common mistake is omitting the ref for fn, causing a stale closure where the debounced call always uses the fn from the first render rather than the latest prop.
